description:
[CONSTRUCTION ROOT] Address source-contract variables AT the resolver binder — number by structural address, never by encounter.

The proposal's missing DAG node (code-review finding "unify on the kept shadow"), and the root of the whole conflation: resolve.rs numbers type variables by ENCOUNTER (resolve.rs: `TypeVarId(vars.len())` in name classification), so `@spec foo(a, {b,c}, d)` gives a=0,b=1,c=2,d=3 — but d's ADDRESS is a2 (parameter 2, independent of the tuple's field count). Every downstream frame (value_types alpha_normalize, per-position passes, the contract bounds re-key) exists only to recover the canonical form the binder failed to assign.

PRINCIPLE: the binder assigns the address; nothing downstream recovers it. Two binders only — the resolver (source vars) and the compiler2 key-mint (inference vars, already addressed whole-scope, 27.6). Both must address.

FIX (approach A — address at first occurrence; bounds resolve through the map, no re-key):
- Thread a structural address path (&[AddrStep]) through resolve_ty: param i -> [Param(i)], result -> [Result], recursing List->Elem, Tuple field j->Field(j), Arrow param/result, Map->MapField, Resource->Payload.
- In name classification, a free type var's id becomes `address_id(path)` (first occurrence; repeats reuse via the vars map), NOT `TypeVarId(vars.len())`.
- `when`-clause bounds resolve via resolve_ty using the SAME vars map (names already mapped to addresses), so a bound `a: number` is `a0: number` by construction — no substitution, no re-key (this is exactly the friction I hit trying to do it downstream in contract.rs).
- Only one resolver remains (compiler2/resolve.rs); the legacy type_expr resolver is gone. resolve_ty has non-spec callers (resolve_type_expr_body, resolve_type_def) that also share the var-numbering site; give them a root path so they thread cleanly.

SCOPE: this ticket fixes the NUMBERING (resolve.rs). ResolvedSpecDecl keeps {params, result, constraints} shape but its vars are now ADDRESSED (a0, a1, r0; constraints keyed by addresses). The ResolvedSpecDecl -> ResolvedArrow{arrow, names, bounds} restructure + contract.rs projection is fz-hwn.27.9, which now has addressed inputs to project.

CHECKS: lib + fixture matrix green, zero warnings; spec/contract/overload fixtures resolve identically (00049, 00083-00090, 00278, etc.); the resolver emits addressed vars (a0/a1/r0), verified by a unit test on resolve_spec. blocks fz-hwn.27.9.
title: [CONSTRUCTION ROOT] Address source-contract variables at the resolver binder (address, not encounter)
